dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge spline fitting from the apex to the posterior dorsal insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded-acute morphology with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc forming the dorsal-anterior boundary of the cranium.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical extension with a pixel length roughly equal to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-luminescent surface shader with internal light gradients, characteristic of a digital rendering rather than biological texture.
